overview.overview: Where you areThe Journey NorthAt the Guild hall in Aegis City.Wendhope lies two days north along the frontier road, and the talk on the way is the party's own.Something is starting to stir.About this storyYou have just signed on at the Adventurer's Guild in Aegis City, with no party yet. Belle, a headstrong barbarian, and Dalan, a shy elf ranger, are looking for one too. The postings on the board are small, the pay is modest, and every rank has to be earned. Expect frontier fantasy with a dark edge: real danger, mysteries that open one clue at a time, and choices that cost something. Bring any adventurer you like; the Guild takes all kinds.RecentlyYou left The Wendhope Job behind and moved into The Journey North.Open threadsThe Sheridans' impatience: the wealthy patrons behind the Wendhope posting will not tolerate failure or delay.The Second Tries must gather supplies before departing north to Wendhope.Tobias is deliberately sending the party into a posting the Guild knows has swallowed experienced adventurers.The Ash Lanterns must live up to their new name and survive a posting that has already swallowed two C-rank parties.Tobias has warned the party that the Guild is quietly sending them into a known silence, and the Sheridans will not tolerate failure.The story so farThe player arrived in Aegis City three days ago and signed the Adventurers' Guild register, but had no party, and the Guild sent no one out alone. Seeking the Wendhope posting, a silent mining village in the north offering more coin than a collapsed mine should be worth, the player met Belle, a barbarian from the Mountains of Shadow with a greataxe as tall as she was, and Dalan, a quiet elf archer who had drifted between parties for a year.Following along.Waiting for the next reply.The story is deciding how the world answers that.
